author: Ed Salvas
text: This was the first time we contacted Gallis & Son to pump our system.  We are truly impressed with their fast response, friendly and professional manner when interacting with the customer and thorough completion of the job.  Extremely helpful with suggestions, and even produced a location diagram of our tank for future reference.  We have found our new contractor!!  Thank you for a job well done.

author: Vic Vela
text: We have used Gallis for years.  Thier service is reliable and professional.  I highly recommend them for any of your septic needs.

author: Dan Cabey
text: Fantastic customer service both the plumber and technician were amazing. I would highly recommend this company to absolutely anybody very fast and very reliable five stars all the way.

author: Miranda Lynn
text: Ed and his son are great to work with. Not only did they get us scheduled quickly when we had an issue, but they worked efficiently and made sure we understood everything.  They also came back out to change the tank covers, and I appreciated the level of care they took with the lawn and nearby flower bed as well, as one of the covers was partially under the edge of the bed. Overall a great experience and will definitely use their services again.

author: George Perez
text: A+++ service and professionalism.  We’ve owned our home for 26 years and have used Gallis & Sons two decades.  They’ve always been courteous and prompt.  Recently had a home maintenance emergency with our system and they came out immediately to help us.  We couldn’t be more grateful for your expertise and support. Thank you!
